AddressProposalPayload.description:
A pair-level ``address_rule`` proposal: flat for one stage, or carrying ``stages`` when a sturdy change point
was confirmed (P18f). ``change_from`` marks a change proposal for a pair the glossary already rules.

AddressStagePayload.description: One time-windowed stage inside a multi-stage pair ``address_rule`` proposal (P18f).

adopted.description: ``null`` in a dry run: nothing is adopted.

AdoptAnswer.description:
``POST /api/units/{id}/versions/{v}/adopt``. With ``apply_style`` the answer adds the style kept and what it flags
stale in the other episodes; with ``dry_run`` only that, and ``adopted`` is ``null``.

adopted.description: Units made or given a source.

Applied.description: What ``apply`` did: adopted the candidate (``adopted``, and ``style`` when asked), or wrote cue edits.

BackupBody.title: BackupBody
BackupBody.description: Keys go into a manual backup only when ``include_keys`` is exactly ``true``; anything else reads as no.

BulkAnswer.description: Accept every pending suggestion of one series; a dry run only counts.

unit_id.description: Set once the worker keeps a unit for the item; it opens the Episode or Unit page.

gone.description: Bazarr stopped listing it; the worker still keeps its translations and history.

open_jobs.description: ``requested``, ``running``, ``waiting``: open jobs of the series by state.

synced_at.description: Unix seconds of the last accepted read of Bazarr, or ``null`` before the first one.

items.description: Items of the last read, and items the catalog lists now.

CatalogStatus.description:
The catalog's age and state. ``status`` is ``ok`` (the last read was applied), ``kept`` (it was set aside and
``warning`` says why) or ``""`` (no read yet). ``shrink`` is only in ``GET /api/catalog/status``.

reason.description: Why ``auto_request`` has not asked for this Missing item yet; ``bootstrap`` = its series' glossary awaits review.

CatalogTarget.description: One (item, language): the content axis, the job axis and the decision, with the label the console shows.

address.description: Older cards may hold ``(to, form)`` pairs; the form never writes them (the glossary's Forms of address do).

CharacterCard.description: The Voice of a character (UX §6.3): how they speak and where their style differs from the series'.

CharacterPayload.description: A character a generator proposes: its Name (glossary entry) and, optionally, its Voice (the card).

media_temp.description: Leftover temporary files beside subtitles in media folders: listed, never deleted.

CleanupAnswer.description: ``POST /api/cleanup``: a preview unless the request said ``dry_run: false``.

CleanupBody.title: CleanupBody
CleanupBody.description: A preview unless ``dry_run`` is exactly ``false`` (FR-13.4): any other value reads as ``true``, the side that deletes nothing.

CleanupGroup.description: One group of the clean-up. ``window`` is days, or how many copies to keep (``null`` for temporary files).

CompareAnswer.description: ``GET /api/units/{id}/versions/{v}/compare``: the current translation and one version, cue by cue.

judge.description: Present only where the judge has looked at exactly these two texts.

ConnectionBody.title: ConnectionBody
ConnectionBody.description: ``kind`` names what to test; the key typed in the form comes in the field of that name (``gemini_api_key``, ...).

ConnectionResult.description: The answer of a test of a key or an address; ``auth_failed`` says the service refused the key (not that it was down).

impact.description: ``null`` for a movie (no series to count in).

CorrectionAdded.description:
``POST /api/units/{id}/corrections``. ``ids`` are the corrections made (none for a wider scope); a ``cue_edit``
adds ``version`` and ``warnings``; ``forward`` and ``series`` add ``impact`` and where it starts.

series_id.description: The worker's id of the series (``GET /api/library/series``), not the catalog's.

CorrectionCount.description: Cues of one series in one language whose correction still stands: the size of its golden set, over all time.

n.description: 1-based number in the source subtitle, the one the model sees.

target.description: ``null`` where the target has no such cue (or no target exists).

extract_calls.description: Story-fact reads the jobs would run first (memory on, an episode before the one translated with no facts yet), each episode once for the whole request; 0 when memory is off or the facts are there. Counted apart from ``calls``.

extract_model.description: The model those reads use (``memory_model``), empty when ``extract_calls`` is 0.

Estimate.description: What planned jobs would cost (``services.estimates``): shown in the Estimate/Confirm dialog before anything is queued.

EstimateBody.title: EstimateBody
EstimateBody.description:
A request that spends model calls (retranslate, a variant): ``estimate_only`` is the price, so a client that sends
``"true"`` or ``1`` gets a 400, not a job that was queued for real.

data.description: What the event is about; never a key, a password, a cookie or a header.

EventsAnswer.description: ``GET /api/events``: newest first; ``next_before`` is ``null`` on the last page, ``telemetry`` without a database.

EvidenceItem.description: What shows why: a cue and its timecode, or a line a person can check.

merged.description: Episodes that already had an open job: it was lifted, not made twice.

skipped.description: Episode label to ``no-source`` (nothing to read) or ``cached`` (the newest facts are those of the source as it is).

ExtractAnswer.description: ``POST /api/units/{id}/context/extract``: one ``extract`` job per episode that needs reading.

FromEditsAnswer.description: ``POST /api/suggestions/from-edits``: what the admin's corrections of a series suggested. No model call.

GenerateQueued.description: ``POST /api/suggestions/generate``: the ``suggest`` job (an open one for the same series and language is not made twice).

version.description: How many times it was saved; ``0`` when there is none.

GlossaryCharacter.description: The Name of a character: the translated name, gender and a short description.

from.description: The title of the series copied from.

GlossarySave.description: A save, or a dry run of one (``saved: false``): what it flags stale. Nothing is retranslated.

GlossarySaveBody.title: GlossarySaveBody
GlossarySaveBody.description: Save a glossary as a document or as YAML; ``dry_run`` counts what it would flag stale and saves nothing.

GlossaryTerm.description: A hard rule: where ``source`` shows up, the output says ``target``. ``from``/``until`` are ``S01E06`` (or ``S01E06 00:32:10``).

GoldenSet.description: ``GET /api/series/{id}/golden``: the corrected cues of a series, for ``subcore compare --golden``.

Impact.description: What a change to the rules would do to the translations made without it. Nothing is retranslated.

ImportAnswer.description: ``POST /api/backups/import``: what was restored, the backup taken first, and the zip's own ``backup.json``.

by_model_prompt.description: One row for each model and prompt version that wrote cues together (both fields set).

corrections.description: A series and language with no correction is not listed: it has none.

cps_rate.description: Share of cues the review found over the reading speed.

too_long_rate.description: Share of cues the review found too long.

retranslations.description: Only by model: a retranslation names the model it replaces, not a prompt version (or a pair).

InsightsBreakdown.description: One model, or one prompt version: what it did and how much of it the admin corrected.

calls_by_task.description: Model calls by task: ``translate``, ``extract``, ``judge``, and ``research`` once P16 exists.

research_cost.description: What the ``research`` task cost; ``0`` when there has been none (needs the prices in Settings).

quota_pauses.description: Days of the window on which the daily quota was spent on every model and the queue had to wait for the reset.

validate.description: What the validator saw in a model's reply, by issue.

JobBody.title: JobBody
JobBody.description: The queue buttons that act on one job.

success_rate.description: Done over done and failed; a cancelled job is neither.

retries_per_episode.description: Times a job waited because the provider said no (429, 503), per episode translated.

JobFigures.description: How the jobs that make translations ended in the window.

error.description: The last 300 characters of why it failed.

missing_units.description: ``["S01E03"]``: the earlier episodes a ``context`` wait is for.

JobInfo.description: The job a row can act on (Cancel, Stop, Retry) and what it shows about it.

action.description: ``translate`` (new) or ``retranslate`` (overwrite with version backup) for a planned row; ``""`` when skipped.

JobRow.description: One item a request would make a job for (or, among the skipped, would leave out and ``reason`` says why).

translate_total.description: How many planned jobs translate an episode or movie that has no target subtitle yet.

retranslate_total.description: How many planned jobs retranslate an existing target subtitle (keeping the previous file as a version first).

planned.description: The first 200 rows of each list; the totals count them all.

created.description: A real request only: the jobs made, how many, and how many open ``fill`` jobs were turned into the replacement.

JobsAnswer.description: ``POST /api/jobs``: the plan and what it costs; a real request adds ``created``, ``count`` and ``merged``.

capped.description: More cues differ than one job looks at.

new.description: ``false`` when an open judge job of this candidate was returned instead of a second one.

enabled.description: ``judge_enabled`` in Settings: off by default, because every use spends model calls.

todo.description: Differing cues with no verdict yet.

job.description: The open judge job of this candidate (queued, running or waiting), or ``null``.

JudgeSummary.description: How the judge stands for one candidate (present when the worker has a judge).

JudgeVerdict.description: What the LLM judge thought of one cue: advice, never the admin's pick.

KeyView.description: A stored key as the API shows it: no value, only its last four characters (``""`` for a short key).

KeyWarning.description: What Settings must warn about: ``key-invalid``, ``provider-unconfigured`` or ``model-not-found``.

LayerWindow.description: How far back the counts reach, in days; ``0`` means that kind of job is never deleted.

series_id.description: The worker's own series id (not the catalog id); ``null`` for a movie.

LibraryUnit.description: One episode or one movie with its targets.

LogEntry.description: One event of the worker log; ``details`` holds a traceback.

LoginAnswer.description: ``POST /api/auth/login``: the account that signed in; with authentication off, ``via: "off"`` and no user.

MemoryUnit.description: One episode of ``GET /api/series/{id}/memory``, in story order.

ModelLayers.description: How the default and the strong model are doing, read from the job rows.

OkAnswer.description: A call that only says whether it did something.

PlannedRow.description: One job an estimate would make (or, as a skipped row, would leave out).

PrerequisitesRequested.description: ``POST /api/queue/request-prerequisites``: the jobs made, and the episodes with no source subtitle yet.

PresetImpact.description: A dry run, or a delete of a preset: the counts only.

PresetSaved.description:
An edited preset, with what the edit flags stale (``owners`` is how many series and movies use it). With
``dry_run`` only the counts come back (``PresetImpact``).

current.description: What the current translation says; ``null`` when there is none.

PreviousRates.description:
The five rates of Quality over the window just before this one, as long as it: put next to the figures to say better
or worse. Each is ``null`` when that window has nothing to divide by (or reaches back past a year).

pending_already.description: The same content is waiting in the inbox.

rejected_before.description: The admin said no to exactly this: it is not proposed again.

until.description: Unix seconds when the model may be tried again.

ProviderHealth.description: How one configured model is doing (FR-17.7).

QueueAnswer.description: ``GET /api/queue``: the latest 100 jobs of each state, and the real counts.

cancelled.description: Jobs the admin cancelled or stopped.

title.description: The series, or the movie; empty for a job made before units existed.

kind.description: ``publish`` (a translation; also when the field is absent), ``variant``, ``extract``, ``suggest``, ``judge`` or ``research``.

version.description: ``judge`` jobs: the candidate version being judged.

stored_series_id.description: ``suggest`` and ``research`` jobs: the series (its id in the worker's own library) they are about.

report.description: ``suggest`` and ``research`` jobs: what the run did (``added``, ``auto_accepted``, ``terms``, ``errors``, ...).

QueueJob.description:
One job of ``GET /api/queue``. A job is a stored payload that grows with its kind and its life, so only what a
screen reads is named.

RequestObject.title: RequestObject
RequestObject.description: Any JSON object. The route hands it to a use case that validates it (a glossary, a style, a correction, a setting).

ResearchBody.title: ResearchBody
ResearchBody.description:
``POST /api/suggestions/research``: ``auto_accept`` is the Estimate box's tick for this run only (absent: what
``auto_accept_terms`` says).

used.description: Calls of the research task this series has made over its whole life.

after.description: ``used`` plus the calls this run would make.

terms.description: Terms two or more episodes share that the glossary and the inbox do not have: the ``N`` of the button.

asked.description: How many of them one run asks about (the most widespread first).

calls.description: Model calls: the search and the one that reads its answer (an estimate: a search may run several queries).

auto_accept.description: What ``auto_accept_terms`` says now: the default of the tick in the box.

blocked.description: Why a run cannot be made now; empty when it can.

ResearchEstimate.description: ``POST /api/suggestions/research`` with ``estimate_only``: what a run would look up and spend. No model call.

RetranslateEstimate.description: With ``estimate_only``: the same checks ran, nothing was queued.

RetryBody.title: RetryBody
RetryBody.description: Retry one job (``job_id``), a list of them (``job_ids``) or every failed one (``all``); ``estimate_only`` says the price.

RetryManyAnswer.description: ``POST /api/queue/retry`` for several jobs: ``count`` went back in line, ``skipped`` were left alone.

html.description: Google's own HTML, unchanged: shown as it is, in a sandboxed frame, never edited (its terms).

SearchSuggestions.description: ``GET /api/suggestions/search/{id}``: what Google's grounding returned to be shown next to the result of a search.

SelectionBody.title: SelectionBody
SelectionBody.description: What to request or ignore in the Library: exactly one of ``items``, ``series`` or ``all`` (the use case says so).

SeriesBootstrap.description:
While nothing of a series is approved, ``auto_request`` asks for its first ``limit`` episodes only (FR-15.12).
``locked`` says it is holding the rest back; ``pending`` is how many suggestions wait for review.

policy.description: The series' story-memory switch: ``""`` follows the global ``memory_enabled``.

specials_after.description: Where season 0 sits in the story (``S02E05``); blank is after the last episode of the first season.

SeriesPage.description: ``GET /api/catalog/series/{id}``: one series with the label of every episode and language.

SettingsAnswer.description:
Every setting by its API name (``domain/config.py``; the console's list is ``apps/web/src/lib/settings.ts``).
Only what has a shape of its own is named: the keys, which are never returned (a stored key is ``**********``) and
say what they safely can, the languages and the warnings. The other settings are plain values, and the answer
carries every one of them.

Shrink.description: The last read was set aside only because it listed far fewer items than before: it can be accepted.

bazarr.description: Bazarr's own answer to a ping, or ``{"error": "..."}`` when it could not be asked.

StopAnswer.description: ``POST /api/queue/stop``: ``outcome`` is ``cancelled`` (it had not started) or ``stopping`` (at the next batch).

Style.description: Every field is optional: an axis left out inherits from the layer below (language < preset < series < episode < card).

StyleImpact.description: What a change to the rules would do to the translations made without it. Nothing is retranslated.

effective.description: What is in force once the language and the preset are laid under the owner's own style.

cards.description: The voice of each character that has one (``PUT …/cards``).

StylePreview.description: The trial of a style: sample cues translated with a style that need not be saved. Writes nothing.

StyleSuggestions.description: The genres TMDB gives the series, and the presets that fit them, best first.

payload.description: The glossary entry it would add (a term, an address rule or a character).

undoable.description: An accepted suggestion that changed the glossary can be undone.

edited.description: Accepted after the admin changed it.

search_display_id.description:
The Search Suggestions of the web search a research suggestion came from (``GET /api/suggestions/search/{id}``);
null for the other sources.

SuggestionDecision.description: An accept or an undo, or a dry run of one (``saved: false``): what it flags stale. Nothing is retranslated.

SuggestionSummary.description: ``GET /api/suggestions/summary``: what the badge on the nav shows.

synced_at.description: Unix seconds of the last accepted read of Bazarr, or ``null`` before the first one.

items.description: Items of the last read, and items the catalog lists now.

SyncAnswer.description: ``POST /api/catalog/sync``: the state as it is, and that the background loop was asked to read.

lang.description: ``null`` when the unit has no target.

used.description: The context of the current version of the target; ``null`` when it was made without memory.

now.description: What a translation started now would get.

UnitContextAnswer.description: ``GET /api/units/{id}/context``: stored facts only, never a model call. A movie answers ``applicable: false``.

series_id.description: The worker's own series id (not the catalog id); ``null`` for a movie.

memory_applicable.description: An episode of a series: the Context tab applies.

stored.description: ``false`` until the facts were read; ``facts`` is then ``null``.

UnitFacts.description: ``GET /api/units/{id}/facts``: what the stored facts of an episode say. Read only, never a model call.

UnitStyleAnswer.description: ``GET /api/units/{id}/style``: the episode's own override, the layer above the series'.

exists.description: The target file is on disk.

missing_units.description: ``["S01E03"]``: the earlier episodes the translation was made without.

modified_outside.description: The file on disk is not the version the worker wrote.

removed.description: The admin deleted it: it shows as Missing · Removed and is not requested again.

UnitTarget.description: One target language of a unit: what the history says about its file.

VersionParams.description: How a version was made when its other fields do not say: the range of a retranslation, the style of a variant.

ErrorAnswer.description:
Every refusal of ``/api/*``: ``400`` for input the worker refuses, ``404`` for an id nobody has, ``409`` for a state
that forbids the call, ``500`` for anything unexpected (``docs/API.md``, Errors).
